subject: Negotiation: Cloud Hosting Services - [Your Company]
body:
Hi [Vendor Contact],

I hope this message finds you well. As a valued partner, we appreciate the innovations AWS has consistently brought to our cloud hosting infrastructure. Given the significant growth forecast in the public cloud hosting market, we believe this is an opportune moment to optimize our existing agreement further.

Telnyx's pricing offers, such as $0.023 per GB for storage and competitive costs for operations and egress, underscore the need to align our expenses more closely with market realities. AWS's leadership position, comprising 33% market share, and ongoing technological advancements motivate us to continue leveraging AWS's platform. Hence, we propose negotiating a 15% reduction in our current hosting expenses, aiming for approximately $380/month.

Could we schedule a brief call this week to discuss this further? Our objective is to develop a mutually beneficial arrangement that continues to support our long-term partnership.

Thank you for considering this proposal.

subject: Negotiation: Adobe Creative Cloud - [Your Company]
body:
Hi [Vendor Contact],

I hope this message finds you well. We value our long-standing partnership and the robust features Adobe Creative Cloud brings to our design capabilities. As we approach the contract renewal date on September 15, 2026, I’d like to discuss the potential for revising our current subscription terms.

Currently, we are evaluating competitive alternatives such as the Affinity V2 Universal License, which offers a comprehensive suite for a one-time payment of $164.99, and free platforms like Inkscape and GIMP. These alternatives, though not as feature-rich, provide substantial cost benefits.

Given the upcoming price adjustment set for November and our desire to continue leveraging Adobe’s advanced AI features, we are aiming for a 15% discount off our existing $80/month rate. This adjustment would ensure Adobe remains our vendor of choice, aligning with our budgetary goals amidst market options.

Could we schedule a brief call this week to explore this opportunity further? We are keen to continue benefiting from Adobe's advancements while ensuring the relationship remains mutually beneficial.

Looking forward to your positive response.

Best regards,

subject: Negotiation: Business Fiber Internet - Your Company
body:
Hi [Vendor Contact],

I hope this message finds you well. I am reaching out to discuss our current agreement for the Business Fiber Internet service, which stands at $120/month for a 500 Mbps connection, set to expire in June 2026.

In evaluating our service costs, I noticed offerings from key competitors that present viable, cost-effective alternatives. For instance, Quantum Fiber offers a similar 500 Mbps plan at $50/month, and Verizon Business Fios at $99/month provides symmetrical speeds which align with our operational needs.

Given these competitive market offerings and industry benchmarks which typically range from $50 to $100/month, we seek to realign our current arrangement. Specifically, I propose a 30% discount, aiming to adjust our rate to approximately $84/month. Alternatively, if feasible, we would appreciate a competitive match to Quantum Fiber’s $50/month rate.

We value the collaborative relationship with your team and are keen on extending this partnership beyond our current contract. Adjusting the pricing in line with market standards will fortify this enduring relationship by aligning our budgetary constraints with available options.

Could we schedule a brief 10-minute call this week to discuss this proposal? I am hopeful for a beneficial resolution that continues to serve both our interests.

Thank you for your attention and understanding.

Best regards,
